articles.title: Pentagon and HHS Launch Investigation Into COVID Vaccine Deaths Among Mandated Military Personnel
articles.summary: The Trump administration has opened a formal investigation into whether COVID-19 vaccines contributed to deaths among U.S. service members forced to take the shots under Biden's military mandate. This is the first federal acknowledgment that mandatory vaccination of troops may have caused fatal harm. If confirmed, it represents one of the most consequential vaccine safety cover-ups in modern American history.

articles.title: GLP-1 Drugs Lower Inflammation Markers While Raising Long-Term Risk — And Nobody Talks About What Happens When You Stop

No clinical trial needed when there's no pill to sell.

This mechanism was hidden in plain sight, unexamined because it defies the standard oncology funding model focused on protein targets. Patients are dying from a resistance mechanism that researchers weren't even asking about.
